decision.rule: D_s3v3 is better than B_s3 iff the VN-cluster 95% interval of CER(D_s3v3) - CER(B_s3) on teacher_val (both views, errors summed over the arm's two seeds) lies entirely below 0 and CER(D_s3v3) - CER(B_s3) < 0 for each seed pair (same seed). Otherwise version 3 is not measured better: version 2 stays synth3's VN-style data and the result is reported as no measured improvement (study 1's rule).
